meta.title: Industries — DESIREFIT
meta.description: DESIREFIT delivers EV charging solutions for fleet operators, commercial real estate, parking facilities, and retail & hospitality sectors.

hero.headline: Charging Solutions Built for Your Sector
hero.subheading: Every industry has unique charging demands. DESIREFIT engineers infrastructure that fits your operational model — not the other way around.

sectors.title: Fleet Operators
sectors.description: Logistics, delivery, and transport companies are electrifying at scale. DESIREFIT fleet depot solutions are engineered for overnight charging, intelligent scheduling, and per-vehicle energy tracking — so your fleet is always ready at shift start.

challenges.text: Minimising energy costs with off-peak scheduling
Integrating with existing fleet management systems
Tracking per-vehicle energy consumption and costs

solutions.text: Smart depot charging with intelligent load management
OCPP 2.0 integration with fleet TMS and ERP platforms
Scalable modular infrastructure — expand as your fleet grows

sectors.title: Commercial Real Estate
sectors.description: EV charging is rapidly becoming a baseline tenant expectation and a regulatory requirement. DESIREFIT helps property developers and managers future-proof their assets with scalable, managed charging infrastructure that adds value and meets sustainability targets.

challenges.text: Meeting tenant EV charging expectations and mandates
Managing electrical capacity across multi-tenant buildings
Billing individual tenants for energy consumption
Scaling infrastructure as EV adoption increases

solutions.text: Multi-tenant billing and white-label management platform
Dynamic load balancing to protect building electrical capacity
Modular infrastructure designed for phased expansion
Full compliance with EV-ready building codes and standards

sectors.title: Parking Facilities
sectors.description: Public and private parking operators can generate new revenue streams while meeting growing EV driver demand. DESIREFIT delivers integrated payment, access control, and real-time availability for seamless driver experiences.

challenges.text: Generating revenue from underutilised parking bays
Managing access and payment for public charging
Providing real-time charger availability to drivers
Maintaining high uptime across a distributed network

solutions.text: Integrated payment terminals and contactless billing
Real-time availability data via app and signage integration
RFID and access control for reserved or managed bays

sectors.title: Retail & Hospitality
sectors.description: EV charging increases customer dwell time and drives repeat visits. DESIREFIT helps retailers, hotels, and hospitality venues deploy branded charging experiences that attract EV-driving customers and support sustainability commitments.

challenges.text: Offering a branded, premium charging experience
Managing energy costs across multiple locations
Reporting on sustainability and carbon reduction metrics

solutions.text: Branded charging stations with custom UI and signage
Multi-site management from a single platform
Loyalty and rewards integration via open API
